steps.title: Prepare the 9-hole beam
steps.description: Move the beam into the work area. Counting from its left end, press the two black friction pins into holes 4 and 6 from the far face. Their free ends remain behind the beam.

steps.title: Seat the two gray cross blocks
steps.description: Press each integral pin pair into the near face: holes 1/3 at the left end and 7/9 at the right. The opposite integral pins remain projecting toward you. Each cross block counts as one prepared unit, not five.

steps.title: Insert the upper pins
steps.description: Press one black pin downward into the outer upward-facing hole of each cross block, above beam holes 1 and 9. These seven units remain the fixed datum for the complete Front Part.

steps.title: Front Part 4: Join bracket to outside of one frame rail
steps.description: Join bracket to outside of one frame rail; grey projecting pins face into frame side holes, black vertical pins remain upward.

steps.title: Front Part 5: Insert five side-facing frame connection pins at the shown rail locations
steps.description: Insert five side-facing frame connection pins at the shown rail locations; two arrows plus three already-inserted instances define placement.

steps.title: Front Part 6: Build two white double-cross connectors, each with blue3-pin inserted axially through one end cross hole, short pin end emerging above
steps.description: Build two white double-cross connectors, each with blue3-pin inserted axially through one end cross hole, short pin end emerging above.

steps.title: Front Part 7: Attach two white connector units onto frame near motor rail ends, blue ends upward
steps.description: Attach two white connector units onto frame near motor rail ends, blue ends upward; insert six additional upward black frame pins at pictured edge locations.

steps.title: Front Part 8: Prepare medium motor, circular output pointing upward and cable toward lower-right
steps.description: Prepare medium motor, circular output pointing upward and cable toward lower-right; set output index marks as inset, insert blue3-pins laterally into housing mount holes.

steps.title: Front Part 9: Fit blue and green cable clips on opposite sides of medium motor housing
steps.description: Fit blue and green cable clips on opposite sides of medium motor housing.

steps.title: Front Part 10: Lower medium motor onto prepared frame mount
steps.description: Lower medium motor onto prepared frame mount; cable traverses frame opening, circular output upward.

steps.title: Front Part 11: Insert four lateral black pins into magenta 1x3x3 connector block, two at each side
steps.description: Insert four lateral black pins into magenta 1x3x3 connector block, two at each side.

steps.title: Front Part 12: Attach grey I-frame side bracket to magenta block
steps.description: Attach grey I-frame side bracket to magenta block; add one blue pin at bracket side.

steps.title: Front Part 13: Attach red cable clip to blue pin on I-frame bracket
steps.description: Attach red cable clip to blue pin on I-frame bracket.

steps.title: Front Part 14: Lower magenta-and-grey bracket over medium motor, pinning to surrounding frame connectors
steps.description: Lower magenta-and-grey bracket over medium motor, pinning to surrounding frame connectors.

steps.title: Front Part 15: Rotate camera to opposite side
steps.description: Rotate camera to opposite side; add second grey I-frame bracket on other motor side.

steps.title: Front Part 16: Prepare first color sensor with two blue3-pins pointing upward from mount side
steps.description: Prepare first color sensor with two blue3-pins pointing upward from mount side.

steps.title: Front Part 17: Attach grey four-pin beam to sensor side using protruding mount pins
steps.description: Attach grey four-pin beam to sensor side using protruding mount pins; sensor lens remains unobstructed.

steps.title: Front Part 18: Press white19mm ball into Medium Azur ball-cup frame
steps.description: Press white19mm ball into Medium Azur ball-cup frame; ball surface protrudes downward in final driving orientation.

steps.title: Front Part 19: Join first ball-cup frame to first color-sensor unit using grey connector
steps.description: Join first ball-cup frame to first color-sensor unit using grey connector.

steps.title: Front Part 20: Insert two black pins into visible side holes of ball-cup frame
steps.description: Insert two black pins into visible side holes of ball-cup frame.

steps.title: Front Part 21: Attach Medium Azur L-shaped3x5 beam to this caster/sensor unit
steps.description: Attach Medium Azur L-shaped3x5 beam to this caster/sensor unit; long arm projects toward center of eventual front rail.

steps.title: Front Part 22: Attach first caster/sensor unit to front frame/motor side
steps.description: Attach first caster/sensor unit to front frame/motor side; sensor is outboard and downward-facing after final rotation.

steps.title: Front Part 23: Prepare second color sensor with two blue3-pins
steps.description: Prepare second color sensor with two blue3-pins.

steps.title: Front Part 24: Attach second grey four-pin beam to second sensor, mirrored placement
steps.description: Attach second grey four-pin beam to second sensor, mirrored placement.

steps.title: Front Part 25: Prepare second white ball in Medium Azur ball-cup frame
steps.description: Prepare second white ball in Medium Azur ball-cup frame.

steps.title: Front Part 26: Join second caster frame to second sensor unit
steps.description: Join second caster frame to second sensor unit.

steps.title: Front Part 27: Insert two black side pins into second ball-cup frame
steps.description: Insert two black side pins into second ball-cup frame.

steps.title: Front Part 28: Attach second3x5 angular beam, mirrored relative to first sensor/caster
steps.description: Attach second3x5 angular beam, mirrored relative to first sensor/caster.

steps.title: Front Part 29: Attach second caster/sensor unit on other motor side
steps.description: Attach second caster/sensor unit on other motor side.

steps.title: Front Part 30: Add black15-hole rail spanning two sensor/caster units across front
steps.description: Add black15-hole rail spanning two sensor/caster units across front.

steps.title: Front Part 31: Make two yellow2x4 cross-hole brick units, two red axle/pins per brick, axles entering holes in brick face opposite studs
steps.description: Make two yellow2x4 cross-hole brick units, two red axle/pins per brick, axles entering holes in brick face opposite studs.

steps.title: Front Part 32: Slide one short black tube onto one red pin in each yellow brick unit
steps.description: Slide one short black tube onto one red pin in each yellow brick unit.

steps.title: Front Part 33: Mount both yellow brick units atop outer front supports, studs outward/up in displayed orientation
steps.description: Mount both yellow brick units atop outer front supports, studs outward/up in displayed orientation.

steps.title: Front Part 34: Make two magenta connector blocks, each with two upward black pins
steps.description: Make two magenta connector blocks, each with two upward black pins.

steps.title: Front Part 35: Attach the two magenta connector blocks alongside motor, their pinned edges upward
steps.description: Attach the two magenta connector blocks alongside motor, their pinned edges upward.

steps.title: Front Part 36: Rotate camera to opposite end
steps.description: Rotate camera to opposite end; no additional parts.

steps.title: Front Part 37: Insert two black pins into opposing round holes of grey28-tooth double-bevel gear
steps.description: Insert two black pins into opposing round holes of grey28-tooth double-bevel gear; not into center cross axle hole.

steps.description: Mount grey gear on circular medium-motor output, using the two pin connections; no external tool is added.

warnings: Cable paths and lengths are not shown accurately in 3D. Follow the official wiring diagram and check cable reach before connecting.

steps.title: Connect the color sensors to B and F
steps.description: Plug the two front color-sensor cables into ports B and F. Follow the crossed cable assignment in the official wiring diagram.
warnings: Cable paths and lengths are not shown accurately in 3D. Follow the official wiring diagram and check cable reach before connecting.

steps.title: Connect the left drive motor to A
steps.description: Plug the left large motor’s attached cable into port A. Keep the completed left module beside the front assembly for now.
warnings: Cable paths and lengths are not shown accurately in 3D. Follow the official wiring diagram and check cable reach before connecting.

steps.title: Connect the rear motor to C
steps.description: Plug the rear medium motor’s cable into port C. This motor drives the rear tool output.
warnings: Cable paths and lengths are not shown accurately in 3D. Follow the official wiring diagram and check cable reach before connecting.

steps.title: Connect the right drive motor to E
steps.description: Plug the right large motor’s cable into port E. Check all six hub connections against the official wiring diagram.
warnings: Cable paths and lengths are not shown accurately in 3D. Follow the official wiring diagram and check cable reach before connecting.

steps.title: Attach the left drive module
steps.description: Bring the completed left module to the front frame. Align its two housing pins with the matching frame holes and press the module into place.

steps.title: Attach the right drive module
steps.description: Bring the completed right module to the opposite side of the front frame. Check its mirrored orientation before aligning and seating the housing pins.

steps.title: Lower the hub into the chassis
steps.description: Lower the hub onto the upper supports between the drive modules. The rear module’s upper axles will retain it in the next step.

steps.title: Position the rear module
steps.description: Bring the rear module toward the blue pins on the drive modules, with its two upper axles facing the hub holes. Compare these connections with Book 5 before trying to join them.
warnings: The rear mounting points do not align in this 3D guide: the modeled spans differ by 32 mm. Check Book 5 before joining the rear module. Do not force the parts to match the animation.

steps.title: Check the rear connections
steps.description: Inspect the four lower side-pin positions and the upper axle-to-hub connections from this side. Compare the gaps with the official illustration; pause if the parts do not align.
warnings: The rear mounting points do not align in this 3D guide: the modeled spans differ by 32 mm. Check Book 5 before joining the rear module. Do not force the parts to match the animation.

steps.title: Prepare the second upper frame
steps.description: Fit two red axle/pins into the long-edge transverse holes of the magenta 11 × 7 frame. Build this small assembly beside the robot.

steps.title: Fit the front upper frame
steps.description: Align the prepared frame with the four upright pins around the front motor and lower it into place. Rotate the view to check all four connections.

steps.title: Insert both 5L stop axles
steps.description: Insert the two reddish-brown 5L stop axles through the upper side supports. Their stop shoulders determine how far they seat.

steps.title: Retain the axles from below
steps.description: Look underneath the robot and press the two gray bushes onto the projecting axle ends.

steps.title: Prepare the first underside frame
steps.description: Fit the gray cross block with four integral pins to one black 7 × 5 frame.

steps.title: Join the underside frames
steps.description: Attach the second black 7 × 5 frame to the opposite pair of pins on the gray cross block. Keep the 8 mm gap between the frame bodies.

steps.title: Insert the outer-corner pins
steps.description: Insert one black pin into each of the four outer corner holes of the paired frames.

steps.title: Fit the underside reinforcement
steps.description: Align the paired frames with the four receiving points underneath the robot and attach them. Return the view upright when finished.

steps.title: Check the completed assembly
steps.description: Compare the upright robot with the final official illustration. Check the frame connections and wiring before trying the movement demonstration.
